symptom.name: Machine Stop during Cut Due to Unintentional pause
symptom.description: The machine stops in middle of cut and displays message Machine Paused.

failure_modes.name: Intermittent pause circuit, usually in the stop discs
failure_modes.description: The cut interruption is typically caused by an intermittent pause circuit, usually in the stop discs.

corrective_actions.name: Tighten the plunger to increase activation pressure
corrective_actions.description: Tighten the plunger to increase activation pressure and loosen to decrease activation pressure.
corrective_actions.instruction_text: Tighten the plunger to increase activation pressure and loosen to decrease activation pressure.
corrective_actions.source_title: Eastman Eagle S3L Laser Cutting System Service Manual

symptom.name: The buttons on the Touch Screen are out of alignment
symptom.description: The touch screen buttons do not match where the screen needs to be touched.

failure_modes.name: Touch screen calibration is required
failure_modes.description: Touch screen calibration is required when buttons are out of alignment.

corrective_actions.name: Select save and exit to complete calibration
corrective_actions.description: Navigate to screen page 3 and select save and exit to complete calibration.
corrective_actions.instruction_text: Calibrate the touch screen. Select save and exit to complete calibration.
corrective_actions.source_title: Eastman Eagle S3L Laser Cutting System Service Manual

symptom.name: The Cutting Tool or Pen does not move down
symptom.description: The tool or Pen does not move down when cutting a file.

failure_modes.name: Layer is not mapped to a tool or the tool is not on the tool holder
failure_modes.description: The layer is not mapped to a tool or the tool is not on the tool holder.

corrective_actions.name: Click and drag the tool to the spindle or the layer to the tool
corrective_actions.description: Click and drag the tool to the spindle or the layer to the tool before sending the file to the cutter.
corrective_actions.instruction_text: Adjust the tool and layer mapping. Click and drag the tool to the spindle or the layer to the tool before sending the file to the cutter.
corrective_actions.source_title: Eastman Eagle S3L Laser Cutting System Service Manual

symptom.name: Laser Fume Extractor has reduced vacuum or no vacuum
symptom.description: An odor is present when cutting with the laser tool or Laser cutting path is wider than normal.

failure_modes.name: Vacuum filters require replacement
failure_modes.description: The fume extractor vacuum filters require replacement.

failure_modes.name: Vacuum hose and funnel require cleaning
failure_modes.description: The vacuum hose and funnel require cleaning.

corrective_actions.name: Replace vacuum filters
corrective_actions.source_title: Eastman Eagle S3L Laser Cutting System Service Manual

corrective_actions.name: Clean vacuum hose and funnel
corrective_actions.source_title: Eastman Eagle S3L Laser Cutting System Service Manual

symptom.name: Laser cutting path is too wide
symptom.description: The laser cutting path increases to an undesirable width.

failure_modes.name: Brass laser nozzle bent
failure_modes.description: The tube or nozzle is bent, so the laser beam reflects off the inside wall of the nozzle causing a wide path.

failure_modes.name: Damage to brass laser nozzle
failure_modes.description: Damage to brass laser nozzle can make the cutting path too wide.

failure_modes.name: Beam mirrors out of adjustment
failure_modes.description: The mirrors may need to be adjusted, widening the laser cutting path.

corrective_actions.name: Replace nozzle if any damage is present
corrective_actions.description: Replace nozzle if any damage is present.
corrective_actions.instruction_text: Replace nozzle if any damage is present.
corrective_actions.source_title: Eastman Eagle S3L Laser Cutting System Service Manual

corrective_actions.name: Replace nozzle if any damage is present
corrective_actions.description: Replace nozzle if any damage is present.
corrective_actions.instruction_text: Replace nozzle if any damage is present.
corrective_actions.source_title: Eastman Eagle S3L Laser Cutting System Service Manual

corrective_actions.name: Adjust the mirrors
corrective_actions.description: Adjust the mirrors when the laser cutting path is too wide.
corrective_actions.source_title: Eastman Eagle S3L Laser Cutting System Service Manual

symptom.name: Loss of laser cutting power
symptom.description: The laser cutting power decreases causing non-cut edges.

failure_modes.name: Damaged or dirty lens
failure_modes.description: The focusing lens is damaged or dirty.

failure_modes.name: Damage, burn mark or dirt on the beam deflecting mirrors
failure_modes.description: The beam deflecting mirrors have damage, burn mark or dirt.

failure_modes.name: Damage or debris in laser nozzle
failure_modes.description: Damage or debris in laser nozzle reduces cutting power.

corrective_actions.name: Clean or replace lens as required
corrective_actions.description: Clean or replace lens as required.
corrective_actions.instruction_text: Clean or replace lens as required.
corrective_actions.source_title: Eastman Eagle S3L Laser Cutting System Service Manual
